description: Use this only after the customer has chosen a route, time and vehicle and has given their name, email and phone, and explicitly asked to send the request. Submits a transfer REQUEST that is stored as pending and reviewed by the operator, who confirms the ride and final price by email/WhatsApp. This does NOT confirm a booking, assign a driver or take payment — never tell the customer the ride is confirmed. Writes data: do not call it to explore prices (use get_price_quote) and do not retry on success. Pass idempotencyKey to make retries safe: the same key for the same customer returns the original reference (duplicate=true) and never creates a second request; to change details, cancel and submit a new request with a new key. Without a key, repeating identical details also returns the original request. At most 5 requests per phone number per day. Capacity is checked: parties larger than the vehicle are rejected with a suggested vehicle.

customerEmail.description: Where the reference and confirmation are sent

customerName.description: Full name of the lead passenger

customerPhone.description: International format with country code, e.g. +905551234567

dropoffAddress.description: Drop-off place or hotel name with its area

flightNumber.description: Flight number without spaces, e.g. TK2548

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (e.g. a UUID) you generate once per customer request and reuse on every retry. A retry with the same key and same customer email/phone returns the original reference with duplicate=true and creates nothing, even if other fields changed.

language.description: Customer language code, e.g. en, ru, de, tr

notes.description: Extra instructions for the operator (hotel address, special needs)

pets.description: Pets travelling (the operator confirms whether they can be carried)

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time of pickup in Antalya local time, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00+03:00. If no timezone is given, Antalya time (UTC+3) is assumed. For arrivals use flight landing time plus ~30 minutes.

vehicleType.description: Vehicle class; must fit passengers, luggage and child seats

name: create_transfer_request

duplicate.description: true: no new request was created; the original is returned

operatorConfirmed.description: false: this is a request, not a confirmed ride

status.description: New requests are pending. With duplicate=true this is the original request's current status. Only operatorConfirmed=true means the ride is confirmed.

title: Submit transfer request (pending operator confirmation)
